description: Meets the medical-necessity criteria 1/2/3 (severe MDD + rating scale, two failed med trials, failed psychotherapy) BUT a contraindication is present: a documented seizure disorder and an implanted vagus nerve stimulator within 30 cm of the coil site (policy #297 Contraindications a and d). Patient has a documented history of a generalized seizure disorder and an implanted vagus nerve stimulator located within 30 cm of the intended TMS coil site.
